description: Ross and Rachel untangle their accidental Vegas marriage as Monica and Chandler move in together and progress from secret romance toward engagement, while Joey's acting career and the group's shifting living arrangements keep disrupting everyday life.

s06e01.description: Ross and Rachel wake up married and disagree over annulment, while Monica and Chandler reconsider rushing into marriage and Joey and Phoebe race home from Las Vegas.

s06e02.description: Ross secretly avoids getting the annulment because he cannot face another failed marriage, while Chandler and Monica argue over moving in together.

s06e03.description: Ross refuses to admit he still has feelings for Rachel as Chandler prepares to move in with Monica and Joey struggles with the loss of his roommate.

s06e04.description: Joey injures himself after losing health insurance and delays treatment, while Ross is eager to impress students on his first day teaching at NYU.

s06e05.description: Joey pretends a parked Porsche belongs to him to attract attention, while Rachel and Ross finalize their annulment and Monica and Chandler clash over household finances.

s06e06.description: Chandler tries to give Joey money before moving out without hurting his pride, while Rachel and Monica's last night as roommates dissolves into a sentimental argument.

s06e07.description: Rachel is embarrassed by Phoebe's wildly unconventional running style until she learns to enjoy it, while Joey searches for a new roommate after Chandler moves out.

s06e08.description: Ross over-whitens his teeth before a date and spends the evening trying to hide them, while Phoebe worries Rachel's new coworker may be interested in Ross.

s06e09.description: Thanksgiving exposes long-buried family secrets when Ross and Monica blame each other for old misdeeds, while Rachel's disastrous trifle combines dessert with shepherd's pie.

s06e10.description: Ross and Monica revive their childhood dance routine for a televised New Year's special, while Joey tries to get closer to Janine and Phoebe and Rachel search Monica's apartment for Christmas gifts.

s06e11.description: Rachel buys furniture from Pottery Barn despite Phoebe's hatred of mass-produced goods, while Joey and Janine begin dating and Chandler feels increasingly excluded.

s06e12.description: Ross and Chandler argue over authorship of a joke published in Playboy, while Monica is offended that Phoebe considers Rachel the better potential girlfriend.

s06e13.description: Rachel's spoiled sister Jill arrives after being cut off financially and immediately becomes interested in Ross, forcing Rachel to confront her own feelings.

s06e14.description: Monica worries that Chandler never cries and tries to provoke an emotional response, while Rachel's sister Jill continues pursuing Ross.

s06e15-16.description: The friends imagine alternate lives in which Rachel married Barry, Ross stayed with Carol, Monica remained overweight, Chandler pursued writing, Joey became a major star and Phoebe became a ruthless executive. The imagined alternate lives unravel in unexpected ways, showing that different careers and relationships would still draw several of the friends toward familiar emotional connections.

s06e17.description: Ross claims years of martial arts training have given him perfect awareness, prompting Rachel and Phoebe to ambush him repeatedly, while Chandler searches for a handmade Valentine's gift for Monica.

s06e18.description: Ross begins dating one of his students despite the professional risk, while Rachel and Phoebe's apartment catches fire and the women argue over who gets to stay with Monica.

s06e19.description: Joey's broken refrigerator leads him to absurdly demand money from everyone nearby, while Rachel worries about Ross dating Elizabeth and Phoebe, Monica and Chandler compete over finding a date.

s06e20.description: Joey waits for a career-changing audition and the group recalls earlier moments in his acting life, especially Chandler's long-running support of his ambitions.

s06e21.description: Ross tries to impress Elizabeth's intimidating father Paul, while Paul becomes attracted to Rachel and Joey nearly sabotages his own television opportunity.

s06e22.description: Ross and Elizabeth hide their relationship at her father's country house, while Rachel discovers an unexpectedly emotional side of Paul and Monica begins planning her future wedding.

s06e23.description: Chandler secretly shops for an engagement ring with Phoebe, only to panic when the perfect ring is sold to someone else.

s06e24-25.description: Chandler attempts to make his proposal a surprise by pretending he never wants marriage, but Monica's former boyfriend Richard reappears and admits he still loves her. Richard offers Monica the future she once wanted, while Chandler abandons his deception and finally proposes to Monica in their candlelit apartment.
